big: A client owns three large-cap funds and thinks she is well spread. Look inside: each holds the same big private banks. Financial services is roughly a third of the Nifty 50.

lines: Which sectors matter most in the Nifty 50?

Financial services is the largest, roughly a third. IT, oil and gas, consumption and autos follow. Defence, capital goods and power have grown their weight lately. Because most large-cap funds own big private banks, check overlap before adding another.
